event_name: Document 30 Date 20 October 2018 Time 20:47 2018 UNITED STATES GRAND PRIX 18 - 21 October 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (document 27) and heard the team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Alleged driving unnecessarily slowly on an In lap during Qualifying.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 27.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations and failing to observe the Race Director's instruction, document 17 (item 16.1)
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video evidence, timing, and positioning data and heard from the team representatives. Car 77 exceeded the specified maximum time between Safety Car Lines on its postqualifying In lap. The Stewards closely examined the drivers In lap and found that Car 77 did not drive unnecessarily slowly or in a manner to adversely affect any other driver. Noting all the circumstances involved, the Stewards take no further action.
rules_referenced: Article 27.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations and failing to observe the Race Director's instruction
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Doc 30 2018 United States Grand Prix Decision Car 77 Alleged Driving Unnecessarily Slowly
